label: TP
reason: User-supplied cookie value flows directly into fileName via Base64 decode/encode roundtrip, then is used in Files.newInputStream() for arbitrary file read (path traversal risk), and also encoded into HTML output. The sanitization attempts (Base64 encode/decode) do not prevent traversal characters or other XSS vectors, making this a genuine vulnerability on the reported paths.

evidence.note: User cookie value decoded and processed through Base64 transformations, then used in file I/O and HTML output sinks
